summary: Live. Of the agents in scope, 5 of 5 meet the bar to work on their own (Requirement extraction, Red-flag detection, Norms and standards, Configuration (CPQ), Technical documentation). Tenders lose most time in the queue for commercial review (1.2 days per tender). About 3,293 hours a year come back, 1,980 of them in sales engineering: the work of 2.2 people, worth 333,501 EUR against a fee of 72,000. Half of all bids go out within 2.9 days instead of 6.5 (between 3.4 and 3.8 days faster, 90 % of resamples).
